name: com.gamedistrict.maxeventtracker
description: Grouped custom analytics events (ad activity, gaming, generic, social, subscription). SDK-agnostic: the game passes an IEventBackend adapter (AppLovin MAX / Metica sample included).

samples.description: MaxSdkEventBackend, MeticaSdkEventBackend and EventBackendFactory (creates one from a TrackingEventsType). Import into Assets so they compile alongside your SDKs, however those are installed.
